- Non-slip rubber outsole for strong traction
- Breathable mesh inner for lasting comfort
- Care Instructions: Hand wash only

15278293614752.title: JANAN GOLD - 100ml
15278293614752.description:
J. brings to you a masterpiece by the name of Janan which has been composed by carefully handpicking the finest of ingredients from a wide range of striking medleys in order to meet your taste.

It is a perfect harmony of leather with a blend of chypre and musky inspiration which overall is revitalized by the fruity origins that make it an alluring choice for the genteel spirit.
It starts off with a provocative citrus splurge of bergamot, black currant, red apple, and pineapple.

Once the citrus has played its part, the floral heart of jasmine, rose and birch takes over and showcases their gorgeous notes with a blend of patchouli. The final act of the theatre is played by the musky base of oakmoss and amber which is exquisitely laid on the creamy vanilla base. It assures you a performance to remember.

Category: Fresh, Woody

Main Accords: Bergamot, Fruity (Red Apple, Pineapple), White Floral, Patchouli, Leather, Smokey, Oak Moss

Size: 100ml

10 ml

For hygienic reasons (the eye area is very sensitive) you can apply gently with a clean brush for a better result. It should be applied with light brush strokes on dark circles around the eyes. 15280504799392.description:
This capsule collection celebrates Pakistan's rich cultural heritage through sustainable fabrics, carefully selected colours that adorn power.

Discover Wood Intense, where vibrant spice meets deep, polished woods. It opens with olibanum, cardamom, and orange oil, softened by the gentle sweetness of pear.
At its heart, warm cinnamon and nutmeg blend seamlessly with lavender and rose, creating a refined, aromatic warmth.

Step into the world of Wood Intense, a fragrance where raw depth meets refined warmth. It begins with a captivating burst of olibanum, cardamom, and Guatemala orange oil, brightened by the soft sweetness of pear.
